meaning:
ἐξ-αυτῆς
(a κοινή word, = ἐξ αὐτῆς τ. ὥρας)
at once, forthwith: Mrk.6:25, Act.10:33 Act.11:11 Act.21:32 Act.23:30, Php.2:23.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: She came in immediately with haste to the king, and asked, “I want you to give me right now the head of John the Baptizer on a platter.”
Therefore I sent to you at once, and it was good of you to come. Now therefore we are all here present in the sight of God to hear all things that have been…
Therefore I hope to send him at once, as soon as I see how it will go with me.
